notes_for_editor: Only one source: the tnlandforms.us list. The brief's agency (Cherokee National Forest) is not confirmed by any source read; the table does not say what the 'cnf' code means; a history note on the page uses CNF for the Cherokee National Forest but does not tie that to this site. Searches found a YouTube video titled as a Hemlock Knob fire tower site, but its page gave no text, and an AllTrails trail page returned no readable content. The Hemlock Knob tower history needs a Cherokee National Forest or Tennessee Division of Forestry source before the story can say more.
